name: TRUE_RETENTION
definition: fraction of the nutrient/compound in the whole food retained after processing, accounting for weight change
assigned_when: source names it true retention (Bognar TRUE_RETENTION)

name: APPARENT_RETENTION
definition: ratio of concentrations (per unit weight) after/before, no yield correction

name: YIELD_ADJUSTED_RETENTION
definition: retention including a yield/water-change correction as stated by the source
assigned_when: source description says so (Phenol-Explorer: description reported by a secondary snippet, UNVERIFIED against the primary page)

name: TR_OR_AR_UNDISCLOSED
definition: source mixes true and apparent retention and does not mark which per row
